evaluation_archived: The evaluation has attempts or assignments, so it was archived instead of deleted
scenario_not_found: The scenario does not belong to this evaluation
question_not_found: The question does not belong to this evaluation
option_not_found: The option does not belong to this question
management_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage this evaluation
has_submitted_attempts: The evaluation already has submitted attempts, so questions, options, correct answers, points, types and rubrics can no longer change
invalid_status_transition: The evaluation cannot move to that status
not_ready: The evaluation is not ready: check the issues listed in its detail
options_not_allowed: Only single choice, multiple choice and true/false questions have options
invalid_reorder: The new order must list distinct items that belong to this evaluation
invalid_rich_text: The rich text content is not a valid document
media_not_found: One or more media files do not exist
reference_not_found: The module, level, lesson or clinical case does not exist
assignment_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage assignments for this group
not_activatable: Only READY evaluations can be activated
assignment_group_invalid: Every target group must exist, be a student group and be active
assignment_window_invalid: The window must start before it ends, end in the future, and an active assignment can only change its end
assignment_overlap: The evaluation already has an assignment for this group with an overlapping window
assignment_has_attempts: The assignment already has attempts, so it cannot be deleted; close it instead
attempt_resumed: You already have an attempt in progress; it was resumed
not_open: This evaluation is not open for attempts right now
max_attempts_reached: You have already used every attempt allowed for this evaluation
attempt_deadline_passed: The time for this attempt is over; it was submitted with your saved answers
grading_forbidden: You cannot grade attempts of this student group
attempt_not_gradable: The attempt is still in progress, so it cannot be graded yet
attempt_not_graded: Only fully graded attempts can be published
manual_score_invalid: The manual score must be between 0 and the question points
grade_override_comment_required: Overriding an existing score requires a comment
answer_invalid: The answer does not match the question: check the selected options, the text or the simulator session
grade_feedback_regeneration_accepted: The feedback is being generated again
grade_feedback_not_available: Feedback is available once the grade is published
grade_feedback_attempt_not_graded: Feedback can only be generated for a graded attempt
grade_feedback_forbidden: You are not allowed to review this attempt

validation.type_invalid: The type must be EXAM, QUIZ or WORKSHOP
validation.status_invalid: The status must be DRAFT, READY or ARCHIVED
validation.question_type_invalid: The question type must be SINGLE_CHOICE, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, TRUE_FALSE, OPEN_TEXT or SIMULATION
validation.title_too_long: The title must not exceed {constraints.0} characters
validation.description_invalid: The description must be text or a rich text document
validation.positive_integer: The value must be a positive integer
validation.order_invalid: The order must be an integer greater than or equal to 0
validation.sort_by_invalid: The sort field must be createdAt, updatedAt, title or order
validation.content_must_be_object: The content must be a rich text document
validation.media_ids_invalid: mediaIds must be a list of up to 20 media IDs
validation.options_invalid: options must be a list of up to 20 options
validation.points_positive: Points must be a number greater than 0
validation.rubric_must_be_object: The rubric must be an object
validation.items_required: items must list between 1 and 500 items
validation.group_ids_invalid: groupIds must list between 1 and 50 group IDs
validation.date_invalid: The value must be a valid ISO 8601 date
validation.assignment_state_invalid: The state must be UPCOMING, ACTIVE or CLOSED
validation.selected_option_ids_invalid: selectedOptionIds must be a list of up to 20 option IDs
validation.text_answer_too_long: The answer must not exceed {constraints.0} characters
validation.question_id_required: Every answer needs a question ID
validation.answers_invalid: answers must be a list of up to 500 answers
validation.teacher_comment_too_long: The comment must not exceed {constraints.0} characters
